name: 은어 흐르는 시냇가
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly clear mountain stream with silver fish swimming in schools beneath the rippling surface, smooth stepping stones scattered across the current; low-angle water-level composition, open lower-central foreground, cool teal water clarity mixed with warm amber light filtering through overhanging branches, layered streambed depth, glistening pebbles, tranquil fantasy concept art, dappled sunlight scattering across the current.
